```yaml
name: PR Preview Deployment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  deploy-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Get changed documentation files
        id: get_changed_files
        run: |
          python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py
          echo "changed_docs=$(cat changed_docs.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build documentation
        run: |
          mkdocs build --quiet

      - name: Deploy preview
        run: |
          # Deploy to PR-specific directory
          mike deploy --push --update-aliases pr/${{ github.event.number }} latest
          
          # Set preview URL for comment
          echo "PREVIEW_URL=https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.number }}/" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post PR comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const changedDocs = fs.readFileSync('changed_docs.txt', 'utf8').trim();
            
            let commentBody = `### Documentation Preview\n\n[View the preview](${process.env.PREVIEW_URL})\n\n`;
            
            if (changedDocs) {
              commentBody += `#### Changed Documentation Pages:\n${changedDocs}\n\n`;
            }
            
            commentBody += `[View Markdown Source](https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.number }}/source/)`;
            
            // Check if comment already exists and update it
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number
            });
            
            const existingComment = comments.find(comment => 
              comment.body.includes('Documentation Preview')
            );
            
            if (existingComment) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existingComment.id,
                body: commentBody
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: commentBody
              });
            }

  cleanup-preview:
    needs: deploy-preview
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Remove preview
        run: |
          mike delete pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --push
```
